sources.title: Fine-Tuning using LoRA and QLoRA - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Fine tuning updates all the parameters of a pre-trained model to adapt it for a specific task, offering high accuracy but requiring significant computational resources and memory. In contrast, LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a parameter-efficient technique that introduces small trainable matrices into certain layers, allowing most of the original model parameters to remain unchanged.
